name: firecrawl-gateway-monorepo
description: Modular Firecrawl gateway and admin dashboard

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @firecrawl/contracts && npm run build --workspace @firecrawl/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @firecrawl/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @firecrawl/web
scripts.lint: npm run build --workspace @firecrawl/contracts && npm run lint --workspace @firecrawl/contracts && npm run lint --workspace @firecrawl/api && npm run lint --workspace @firecrawl/web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @firecrawl/contracts && npm run test --workspace @firecrawl/contracts && npm run test --workspace @firecrawl/api && npm run test --workspace @firecrawl/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @firecrawl/contracts && npm run build --workspace @firecrawl/api && npm run build --workspace @firecrawl/web
scripts.api:typecheck: npm run build --workspace @firecrawl/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @firecrawl/api
scripts.api:test: npm run build --workspace @firecrawl/contracts && npm run test --workspace @firecrawl/api
scripts.api:build: npm run build --workspace @firecrawl/contracts && npm run build --workspace @firecrawl/api
